readout: option-letter, one forward pass, one output token (typed-decision protocol)
duplicate_letter_tokens: sum probability mass of every token id that decodes to the letter

temperature_rule.fit_set: validation or test splits of public non-JevBench datasets (BoolQ, WANLI, MNLI, BANKING77, CLINC150, CommonsenseQA, SST-5, Yelp-5); never training data
temperature_rule.choice_score: NLL-optimal on the fit set over the grid 0.5-7.0 (step 0.1); Score shares the Choice temperature
temperature_rule.noul: highest fit-set competence (chance-corrected accuracy) on the grid [0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0] among values whose fit-set Noul ECE <= the unmodified base model's own (0.170); 0.2 is the lowest grid value (fit-set ECE 0.167)
